in_english.name: Daliah
in_english.meaning: Beautiful flower, ornamental plant, lovely youth
in_english.long_meaning: Daliah is a feminine name of Arabic origin, meaning beautiful flower, ornamental plant, or lovely youth. The name Daliah is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Yusuf, verse 31. It is one of the names that carry beautiful and delicate meanings, often given to lovely girls. Etymologically, the name is derived from the Arabic root 'D-L-Y' which signifies 'to draw water' or 'to branch out', symbolizing growth and beauty.
